title: fix(pm): the queue guard's pull_request leg attributes to the payload PR and reads the net diff
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8QLWm3LrvmyaxGxb5T2J2Qf)_
Fixes #26316
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` 的 `pull_request` 腿不再按提交拆行:整段 diff 读成一行「合并基点 → head 的净差异」,归到事件载荷里的 PR 号。`merge_group` 腿(按首父提交拆、按标题 `(#N)` 归属、各种拒绝)一字不改。自测加 8 例,两组电池下限按实测抬高。
- **为什么改**:提交标题写的是 issue 号时,预警去读那个 issue 的 reviews(404),报「review list could NOT be read」;分支合过 `origin/main` 时,合并提交的首父 diff 把 main 已落地的几十个路径算进预警,且每行都是「无归属」。预警本来就不会变红,但读的人会被误导。
- **风险与回滚**:只改 PR 上的预警输出,队列腿的输出在两个夹具上逐字节相同(下方附哈希);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:① `enumerateRows`(L2386 起)新的 `pull_request` 分支;② `readEventDiff` 那一行调用(L2794)把事件传进去;③ 自测 decomposition 电池里的 7 个新用例。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test` → 末行 `✓ check-governed-queue-guard self-test: 401 cases pass`(改前 393)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Card #26316's 「Wanted」, and nothing wider. One file, `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`:

1. **`enumerateRows` reads by event.** The `merge_group` reading is the old one, byte for byte: one row per first-parent commit, attributed by `pullNumberFromSubject`, with the `head_ref` fallback only for a one-commit group. On the `pull_request` leg it now returns ONE row: `diff-tree baseSha headSha` (the caller already hands in the merge-base), attributed to the payload's own pull request number, carrying `commits` = the range's first-parent count. Shape chosen: the single net row, because it makes both negatives provable with no intersection logic. The subject is not read for attribution on this leg at all; a subject naming an issue cannot redirect the review read, and a merge of `origin/main` cannot add a path the net diff does not hold.
2. **`readEventDiff` passes `{ event: context.event }`** to it. The merge-base call it already made (L2793) is unchanged; the premise reading in the claim held: the missing piece was the per-commit enumeration, not a merge-base.
3. **`commitsInRange(rows)`** keeps the header line honest: `pull request #N — 3 commit(s) in range` still counts the range's commits. On `merge_group` rows carry no `commits`, so it equals `rows.length`, the old count.
4. **A `runGit(args)` seam** on `enumerateRows`, default `null` (production reads the checkout as before), so the self-test drives the enumeration offline, as its header promises (no network, no git).
5. A header paragraph under *Multi-PR merge groups* states that the `pull_request` leg is not decomposed, and why.

Not touched: `.github/workflows/governed-surface-guard.yml`, `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS`, the register, any refusal text, `decomposeGovernedWork`, `queuedPullsInGroup`, `runSizeGuard`.

## Tests

Self-test 393 → 401 cases, exit 0. Eight new cases, all driven through the `runGit` seam:

- **Battery `decomposition, and the multi-PR group trap`** (floor 6 → 13, measured 13):
  - `⭐ pull_request-leg: a-subject-naming-an-ISSUE-is-attributed-to-the-PAYLOAD-pr-never-the-issue`: the PR #25965 shape (one commit, subject ends `(#25770)`, payload PR 25965) gives one row with PR 25965, governed entry 25965, zero unattributed.
  - `⛔ CONTROL merge_group-leg: the-same-subject-still-attributes-by-its-trailing-number-unchanged`: the same range on `merge_group` still reads 25770 from the subject.
  - `⭐ pull_request-leg: a-branch-that-merged-origin-main-carries-ONLY-its-net-rows-against-the-merge-base`: the PR #26311 shape (own commit, merge of main carrying `.github/workflows/lint.yml`, `AGENTS.md`, `packages/core/src/x.ts`, own commit) gives one governed entry, PR 26311, paths exactly `.github/workflows/governed-surface-guard.yml`.
  - `and-it-reads-the-net-diff-base-to-head-never-a-per-commit-first-parent-diff`: the recorded git reads hold the two-tree `diff-tree` and no `--first-parent` `diff-tree`.
  - `and-the-header-still-counts-the-ranges-three-commits`.
  - `⛔ CONTROL merge_group-leg: the-same-range-is-still-one-row-per-first-parent-commit-unattributed-without-a-subject-number`: three rows, all PR null, the merge row still carries `AGENTS.md`.
  - `and-an-empty-pull_request-range-is-no-rows`.
- **Battery `the pull_request leg is an EARLY WARNING and never reddens`** (floor 5 → 6, measured 6):
  - `⭐ the-early-warning-names-the-payloads-pull-request-and-never-the-issue-its-subject-names`: the rendered warning carries `#25965 — governed` and no `#25770`.

Floor binding checked once: with the decomposition floor at 14 the run exits 1 naming `registered 13 case(s), below its pinned floor of 14`. The self-test's success line is otherwise identical before and after; only the count moves (393 → 401). `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR` (29) is unchanged: no battery added.

## Acceptance notes

The card's three acceptance lines:

- *A `pull_request` run on a PR whose commit subjects name an issue number prints the PR's own review state*: yes, the fixture run below prints `#25965 — governed` where it printed `#25770 — governed` before.
- *A PR whose branch merged `origin/main` prints only the PR's net rows*: yes, 3 unattributed rows (one of them the merge commit's 7 workflow paths) became 1 governed entry with 1 path.
- *`--self-test` green; the `merge_group` cases unchanged*: 401 pass; every pre-existing case passes unedited; the live `merge_group` output on both fixtures is byte-identical before and after (below).

This PR's own `pull_request` run is a live case of the second line: its branch carries a merge of `origin/main` (25 commits of main), so the guard's check-run on this PR should read `pull request #THIS — 2 commit(s) in range` and name no governed path (the diff touches none).

## Verification

Fixtures: a throwaway worktree off `d2ca7079` with two branches built to the card's shapes; payloads point the guard at them; reviews unreachable on purpose (API URL at a closed local port) so the output is deterministic. "Before" = the guard at `d2ca7079`; "after" = this branch.

<details><summary>PR #25965 shape: one commit, subject names issue 25770</summary>

Before:
```text
pull request #25965 — 1 commit(s) in range
Governed Surface Queue Guard — pull_request — 1 governed pull request(s), 0 unattributed governed commit(s), 1 review lookup(s).

  #25770 — governed:
        AGENTS.md ×1 — the repo-root agent instruction file
```
After:
```text
pull request #25965 — 1 commit(s) in range
Governed Surface Queue Guard — pull_request — 1 governed pull request(s), 0 unattributed governed commit(s), 1 review lookup(s).

```
</details>

```text
          - .github/workflows/governed-surface-guard.yml
  ⛔ UNATTRIBUTED — commit d08da36b536b … Merge commit 'd2ca7079…' into fx-b
          - .github/workflows/board-snapshot.yml

```
After:
```text
pull request #26311 — 3 commit(s) in range
Governed Surface Queue Guard — pull_request — 1 governed pull request(s), 0 unattributed governed commit(s), 1 review lookup(s).

  #26311 — governed:
        .github/workflows/** ×1 — CI, deploy and release workflows: what runs on every push, what deploys, what gates the queue
          - .github/workflows/governed-surface-guard.yml
```
</details>

<details><summary>merge_group leg, same two ranges: byte-identical</summary>

`cmp` of before and after, each run with a `merge_group` payload over the same range (`head_ref` naming the PR):

```text
merge_group fixture a: byte-identical (7529 bytes, sha256 04261d5a4b8e70cb)
merge_group fixture b: byte-identical (7666 bytes, sha256 dd83c48111ca9ab5)
```
Fixture b on the queue leg still reads `3 commit(s) in range` and `3 unattributed governed commit(s)`: the queue's decomposition and its refusal are untouched.
</details>

<details><summary>--toolchain-needed on the pull_request leg</summary>

```text
Governed Surface Queue Guard — generator toolchain not needed: 1 commit(s) in range touch no register path the lift recomputes
Governed Surface Queue Guard — generator toolchain not needed: 3 commit(s) in range touch no register path the lift recomputes
```

`--ran` reconciliation (exit codes recorded): `Run reconciliation — 32 derived, 32 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.` · `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 32 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 32 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 32 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).` That reading was taken with `origin/main` at `1c632311`, 2 commits past the merge; the one derived-from file those moved is `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`, which no family on this card's list reads.

Left to CI, as the derivation names: the workflow-payload families (`check:closing-target-claim`'s live leg), `ci.yml · Plan Test Core shards`, the type-check program steps, the repo-wide `pnpm lint`. No package was touched, so there is no build closure and no package test or typecheck to run; this script has no `*.test.ts` beside it, and its own `--self-test` is the suite.
